dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures in the mid-dorsal region exhibit sharp, elliptical perimeters with a high-contrast transition from the dark-gray background to light-gray interior lines. Two posterior 'C' shaped structures display more fragmented edge geometry, maintaining a distinct dark-to-light gradient from the exterior skin to the pattern boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid pixel clusters. Localized, asymmetrical clusters of solid light-gray pixels are primarily concentrated in the anterior cervical region. These clusters lack an internal gradient and appear as isolated, high-contrast patches against the darker pelage.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal 'O' rings form a wide-angled obtuse triangle. The relative distance between the anterior-most and central ring centroids is approximately 1.2 times the distance between the central and posterior-most ring centroids.
